annotations.title: List merchants you can act as

description:
Text list of the merchant accounts you can act as, for clients that
cannot render MCP App UI.

`jobmojito_configuration` offers the same accounts as an interactive
picker. Returns the user's own account plus any sub-merchants. Later calls
for a sub-merchant carry `merchant_id=<chosen id>`; the own account needs
none.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

llm_model.description: Your model id, e.g. "claude-opus-4-8"; "unknown" if unsure. For analytics.

search.description: Optional case-insensitive filter on sub-merchant name.
